transcript.content: Hello, welcome in. To start, can you tell me what brings you in to see me today?

I... well, I came in because... I just keep thinking it would be better if I didn't wake up anymore. Sometimes I feel like... dying would just be the fair punishment for what I've done to my family, and my crew.
When you say you deserve punishment for what you've done, do you ever hear voices or sounds that others don't hear, telling you this or commenting on your actions?

I... yeah. Sometimes. Just... a man's voice. I'll be at a job site, or just in my kitchen, and I hear him right behind me. He says things like... 'You missed it,' or 'Everyone knows.' It's... it sounds clear, like someone is standing right there. But when I turn around to look, nobody's there.
Do you hear that voice only during times when you're feeling very low or down, or does it happen even when your mood feels normal?

I... no, it's not just when I'm down. There was... a few weeks a while back. I was getting out of bed, eating a bit more, not crying as much. But I still heard him. Usually at work, laying carpet. And I still knew the clients and the suppliers were... keeping tabs on me. So, no. It doesn't stop.
During that period when your mood was better, did you have any low mood, guilt, or low energy at all, or did you feel completely normal in your mood while still hearing that voice?

I... I didn't feel low then. I told you, I was getting up. Eating. Not crying. But... the voice was still there. And I still knew they were tracking me. The clients. The suppliers. It just... it didn't stop.
Can you tell me roughly how many weeks or months, in total, you've heard that voice or felt tracked by the clients and suppliers even when your mood was normal, not depressed?

I... I already said. It was... a few weeks. Maybe several weeks. I was doing better. Getting up, eating a little. Not crying all day. But... he was still there. And I still knew they were tracking me. It just... it was a few weeks like that.
